Against it the three counters that measure only the front end's work all FELL - visits 16,818 -> 16,806, allocations 62,110 -> 61,981, peak 825,664 -> 822,004 - because the pub self-seed retired and lib/json shed must and defect. Ruled by Clay 2026-08-25 ('the floor is absolute against refactorings, permeable to the language'): a doctrine-compelled change lands, the floor moves, and the fall is recorded against the change that spent it. The precedent is the 84.79 entry, which has this exact shape. welfare --set refuses a fall by design and did refuse this one; the floor is edited by hand here, which is the override its own comment names, so a reviewer sees it in the diff.
